changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0063. Catalogue status and assignment snapshots for personal-training packages, plus completed sessions and reversible entitlement consumption. Index review: PK on PtSessions and PtSessionConsumptions. UX_PtSessionConsumptions_Session keeps one consumption history row per session. IX_PtSessions_TenantId_Trainer_CompletedOn serves coach period counts. IX_MemberPtAssignments_TenantId_Trainer_Start supports package-sold counts. No extra index on the new snapshot columns because they are read with the assignment row. Performance note: coach reports filter by tenant, trainer, and date.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE app.PtPackages ADD CatalogueStatus NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_PtPackages_CatalogueStatus DEFAULT N'Active';
ALTER TABLE app.PtPackages ADD CONSTRAINT CK_PtPackages_CatalogueStatus CHECK (CatalogueStatus IN (N'Draft', N'Active', N'Inactive'));

ALTER TABLE app.MemberPtAssignments DROP CONSTRAINT CK_MemberPtAssignments_Status; ALTER TABLE app.MemberPtAssignments ADD CONSTRAINT CK_MemberPtAssignments_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'PendingPayment', N'Active', N'Exhausted', N'Expired', N'Cancelled'));
ALTER TABLE app.GymMemberships ADD PtSessionsRemaining INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GymMemberships_PtSessionsRemaining DEFAULT 0;

UPDATE app.GymMemberships SET PtSessionsRemaining = IncludedPtSessions; ALTER TABLE app.GymMemberships ADD CONSTRAINT CK_GymMemberships_PtSessionsRemaining CHECK (PtSessionsRemaining >= 0 AND PtSessionsRemaining <= IncludedPtSessions);

CREATE TABLE app.PtSessions ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, MemberProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TrainerProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, ScheduledStartUtc DATETIME2 NOT NULL, ScheduledEndUtc DATETIME2 NOT NULL, CompletedOn DATE NOT NULL, CompletedAtUtc DATETIME2 NULL, Status NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, Notes NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_PtSessions PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtSessions_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtSessions_MemberProfiles FOREIGN KEY (MemberProfileId) REFERENCES app.MemberProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtSessions_TrainerProfiles FOREIGN KEY (TrainerProfileId) REFERENCES app.TrainerProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_PtSessions_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Scheduled', N'Completed', N'Cancelled', N'Missed')), CONSTRAINT CK_PtSessions_Times CHECK (ScheduledEndUtc >= ScheduledStartUtc) ); CREATE INDEX IX_PtSessions_TenantId_Trainer_CompletedOn ON app.PtSessions (TenantId, TrainerProfileId, CompletedOn) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL AND Status = N'Completed';

CREATE TABLE app.PtSessionConsumptions ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, PtSessionId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, GymMembershipId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, MemberPtAssignmentId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, SessionsConsumed INT NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, ConsumedAtUtc DATETIME2 NOT NULL, ReversedAtUtc DATETIME2 NULL, ReversalReason NVARCHAR(500) NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_PtSessionConsumptions PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtSessionConsumptions_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtSessionConsumptions_PtSessions FOREIGN KEY (PtSessionId) REFERENCES app.PtSessions (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtSessionConsumptions_GymMemberships FOREIGN KEY (GymMembershipId) REFERENCES app.GymMemberships (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtSessionConsumptions_MemberPtAssignments FOREIGN KEY (MemberPtAssignmentId) REFERENCES app.MemberPtAssignments (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_PtSessionConsumptions_Source CHECK ((GymMembershipId IS NOT NULL AND MemberPtAssignmentId IS NULL) OR (GymMembershipId IS NULL AND MemberPtAssignmentId IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT CK_PtSessionConsumptions_Count CHECK (SessionsConsumed = 1), CONSTRAINT CK_PtSessionConsumptions_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Consumed', N'Reversed')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PtSessionConsumptions_Session ON app.PtSessionConsumptions (PtSessionId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_PtSessionConsumptions_TenantId_Membership ON app.PtSessionConsumptions (TenantId, GymMembershipId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL AND GymMembershipId IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_PtSessionConsumptions_TenantId_Assignment ON app.PtSessionConsumptions (TenantId, MemberPtAssignmentId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL AND MemberPtAssignmentId IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_MemberPtAssignments_TenantId_Trainer_Start ON app.MemberPtAssignments (TenantId, TrainerProfileId, StartDate) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL AND TrainerProfileId IS NOT NULL;
